title: Distributed Quantum Computing via Adaptive Circuit Knitting
summary: Distributing quantum workloads over many Quantum Processing Units (QPUs) is a crucial step in scaling up quantum computers toward practical quantum advantage due to the limitations in size of a single QPU. In the absence of high-fidelity quantum interconnects, circuit knitting could provide a path to computing certain properties of large quantum systems on many QPUs of limited size in a distributed fashion using only classical communication.
